These are high-severity defects (4.5-5.0 range). The artifact score is low (1.20) to reflect these catastrophic failures, comparable to or worse than Reference 2 (altar, score 3.0) which had minor issues, and closer to Reference 1 (bannister, score 1.0) which had major structural nonsense.
